name: Kyojuro Rengoku
summary: Kyojuro Rengoku was the Flame Hashira and a major character in the Mugen Train Arc. Despite his father's retirement from the Demon Slayer Corps and refusal to continue teaching him, Kyojuro trained himself using the Flame Breathing instruction books left by previous Flame Hashira. His exceptional skill allowed him to contend with the Upper Rank Three, Akaza.

stats.attackPotency: At least Town level, likely higher
stats.durability: At least Town level, likely higher
stats.liftingStrength: At least Class 25, at most Class 50
stats.strikingStrength: At least Town level, likely higher
stats.range: Extended Melee Range with Nichirin Sword, Several Meters with Breathing Styles

notes: This is Kyojuro's Main Series key. He was able to fight Upper Rank Three Akaza despite suffering severe injuries. His physical performance increased further while near death, reaching Small City level with Death Amp and Relativistic speed. Those near-death values are treated as an amp rather than a separate variant here.
